tagline: International Representative Body for European Inland Waterway Transport
hero_kpi_rationale: The number of participants at the annual congress reflects member engagement and the organization's international reach. With 225 participants in 2024 from 11 European countries, this KPI captures the core activity of sector representation and the cohesion of the inland navigation community.

kpis.name: Annual Congress Participants
kpis.explanation: Total number of participants at the IVR annual congress, reflecting member engagement and international reach.
kpis.description: The IVR annual congress is the flagship event bringing together national representatives from the inland navigation, insurance, and maritime expertise sectors. The number of participants is a key indicator of member engagement and the organization's influence.
kpis.signal: 225 participants from 11 European countries at the 2024 congress in Frankfurt, demonstrating active member engagement and international reach.

kpis.name: Loss Prevention Colloquium Attendees
kpis.explanation: Number of participants at the first annual inland waterway loss prevention colloquium organized by IVR.
kpis.description: The loss prevention colloquium is a new IVR initiative launched in November 2024, gathering insurers, brokers, maritime experts, shipowners, and other inland navigation stakeholders to discuss loss prevention.
kpis.signal: 80 Belgian, Dutch, and German participants at the first loss prevention colloquium in Antwerp, covering technical and financial aspects of incident prevention.

kpis.name: IVR Committee Meetings
kpis.explanation: Number of meetings held annually by IVR's various committees, reflecting operational governance activity.
kpis.description: The committees (Loss Prevention, Legal, Technical, etc.) meet regularly to oversee initiatives, develop recommendations, and ensure the achievement of organizational objectives. In-person meetings indicate strong member commitment.
kpis.signal: The loss prevention committee met three times in 2024 with full physical attendance, demonstrating sustained engagement in governance.

kpis.description: Consolidated annual revenue, value extracted from yfinance.income_stmt over the last four reported fiscal years.
kpis.signal: Total revenue of €6.12 Bn in the latest year

ai_positioning.summary: No mention of artificial intelligence or related technologies in the provided documents. The organization focuses on traditional inland waterway transport regulation, loss prevention, and industry representation.
evidence: No reference to AI, machine learning, APIs or intelligent features
Focus areas are standards development (CESNI), loss prevention, legal framework, and sustainability
